about: One loading-screen hint of ecl::HintManager's array, 0x38 bytes: what a Hint node of Hints.lsx holds.

evidence.says: live dx11, copy attacks, main menu: the 49 entries' bytes +0x14/+0x15/+0x30 read with GK.Memory.Read equal, in order, the Controller/Keyboard/Internal values of the 49 Hint nodes of Public/Game/Hints/Hints.lsx read with Ext.IO.LoadFile; +0x8 (the Description's version) is 1 as the file's version="1"; +0x28 (WikiPage's length) is 0 and +0x2C its capacity 15 for the empty WikiPage
